require_relative "link_network"

module DnsApp
  TYPE_NAMES = { 1 => "A", 2 => "NS", 5 => "CNAME", 6 => "SOA", 12 => "PTR",
                 15 => "MX", 16 => "TXT", 28 => "AAAA" }.freeze
  RCODE_NAMES = %w[NoError FormErr ServFail NXDomain NotImp Refused].freeze
  COUNT_FIELDS = %w[dns.count.queries dns.count.answers dns.count.auth_rr dns.count.add_rr].freeze
  SECTION_FIELDS = %w[dns.answer dns.authority dns.additional].freeze

  module_function

  def type_name(type) = TYPE_NAMES.fetch(type) { "TYPE#{type}" }
  def class_name(value) = value == 1 ? "IN" : "CLASS#{value}"
  def rcode_name(value) = RCODE_NAMES[value] || "RCODE#{value}"

  def label_text(label)
    label.map do |byte|
      byte.between?(33, 126) && ![46, 92].include?(byte) ? byte.chr : format("\\%03d", byte)
    end.join
  end

  def ipv6_notation(address)
    groups = address.each_slice(2).map { |high, low| high * 256 + low }
    best_start = nil
    best_length = 1
    index = 0
    while index < groups.length
      unless groups[index].zero?
        index += 1
        next
      end
      finish = index
      finish += 1 while finish < groups.length && groups[finish].zero?
      if finish - index > best_length
        best_start, best_length = index, finish - index
      end
      index = finish
    end
    texts = groups.map { |group| group.to_s(16) }
    return texts.join(":") if best_start.nil?

    texts[0, best_start].join(":") + "::" + texts[(best_start + best_length)..].join(":")
  end

  class Reader
    def initialize(message)
      @message = message
    end

    def chunk(position, size)
      raise Malformed, "dns: truncated" if position + size > @message.length

      @message[position, size]
    end

    def byte(position) = chunk(position, 1)[0]
    def integer(position, size) = LinkNetwork.read_int(chunk(position, size), 0, size)

    def name(position)
      labels = []
      pointers = 0
      after = nil
      loop do
        length = byte(position)
        if length.zero?
          after ||= position + 1
          break
        elsif length >= 192
          low = byte(position + 1)
          after ||= position + 2
          pointers += 1
          raise Malformed, "dns: compression loop" if pointers > 16

          target = (length - 192) * 256 + low
          raise Malformed, "dns: pointer out of range" if target >= @message.length

          position = target
        elsif length >= 64
          raise Malformed, "dns: bad label type"
        else
          labels << DnsApp.label_text(chunk(position + 1, length))
          position += length + 1
        end
      end
      [labels.empty? ? "<root>" : labels.join("."), after]
    end

    def rdata(type, start, length)
      case type
      when 1 then [LinkNetwork.ipv4_notation(integer(start, 4)), start + 4]
      when 28 then [DnsApp.ipv6_notation(chunk(start, 16)), start + 16]
      when 2, 5, 12 then name(start)
      when 15
        preference = integer(start, 2)
        exchange, finish = name(start + 2)
        ["#{preference} #{exchange}", finish]
      when 6
        primary, position = name(start)
        mailbox, position = name(position)
        parts = [primary, mailbox]
        5.times do
          parts << integer(position, 4).to_s
          position += 4
        end
        [parts.join(" "), position]
      else ["#{length} bytes", start + length]
      end
    end

    def record(position, section, layer)
      owner, position = name(position)
      fixed = chunk(position, 10)
      type = LinkNetwork.read_int(fixed, 0, 2)
      record_class = LinkNetwork.read_int(fixed, 2, 2)
      ttl = LinkNetwork.read_int(fixed, 4, 4)
      length = LinkNetwork.read_int(fixed, 8, 2)
      start = position + 10
      chunk(start, length)
      text, finish = rdata(type, start, length)
      raise Malformed, "dns: bad rdata length" unless finish == start + length

      layer.add(section, "#{owner} #{DnsApp.type_name(type)} #{DnsApp.class_name(record_class)} #{ttl} #{text}")
      layer.add("dns.a", integer(start, 4)) if section == "dns.answer" && type == 1
      start + length
    end
  end

  def dissect_dns(message)
    reader = Reader.new(message)
    header = reader.chunk(0, 12)
    flags = LinkNetwork.read_int(header, 2, 2)
    counts = (4...12).step(2).map { |index| LinkNetwork.read_int(header, index, 2) }
    layer = Layer.new
    layer.set("dns.id", LinkNetwork.read_int(header, 0, 2))
    layer.set("dns.flags", flags)
    layer.set("dns.flags.response", (flags >> 15) & 1)
    layer.set("dns.flags.opcode", (flags >> 11) & 15)
    layer.set("dns.flags.rcode", flags & 15)
    COUNT_FIELDS.zip(counts) { |field, count| layer.set(field, count) }
    position = 12
    counts[0].times do
      name, position = reader.name(position)
      tail = reader.chunk(position, 4)
      layer.add("dns.qry.name", name)
      layer.add("dns.qry.type", LinkNetwork.read_int(tail, 0, 2))
      position += 4
    end
    SECTION_FIELDS.zip(counts.drop(1)) do |section, count|
      count.times { position = reader.record(position, section, layer) }
    end
    layer
  end
end

module Flows
  SEQUENCE_MODULUS = 2**32
  MARKS = %w[retransmission out_of_order lost_segment duplicate_ack].freeze
  CONVERSATION_KINDS = %w[ipv4 tcp udp].freeze

  class Segment
    attr_reader :packet, :number, :time, :source, :destination, :seq, :ack, :window,
                :length, :syn, :fin

    def initialize(packet)
      @packet, @number, @time = packet, packet.number, packet.time
      @source = [packet.value("ip.src"), packet.value("tcp.srcport")]
      @destination = [packet.value("ip.dst"), packet.value("tcp.dstport")]
      @seq, @ack = packet.value("tcp.seq_raw"), packet.value("tcp.ack_raw")
      @syn, @fin = packet.value("tcp.flags.syn"), packet.value("tcp.flags.fin")
      @rst = packet.value("tcp.flags.rst")
      @has_ack = packet.value("tcp.flags.ack")
      @window, @length = packet.value("tcp.window"), packet.value("tcp.len")
    end

    def syn? = @syn == 1
    def fin? = @fin == 1
    def rst? = @rst == 1
    def ack? = @has_ack == 1
    def syn_only? = syn? && !ack?
    def syn_ack? = syn? && ack?
  end

  PreviousAck = Struct.new(:ack, :window, :number, :count)

  class Side
    attr_reader :name, :intervals, :marks
    attr_accessor :isn, :mss, :wscale, :base, :expected, :advanced_at, :previous_ack,
                  :packets, :payload

    def initialize(name)
      @name = name
      @isn = @mss = @wscale = @base = @expected = @advanced_at = @previous_ack = nil
      @intervals = {}
      @packets = @payload = 0
      @marks = MARKS.to_h { |mark| [mark, 0] }
    end
  end

  class Stream
    attr_reader :number, :client, :server, :history, :start, :events, :client_side, :server_side
    attr_accessor :state, :end_time, :packets, :bytes, :syn, :syn_ack, :handshake_ack,
                  :closer, :final_ack

    def initialize(number, client, server, state, segment)
      @number, @client, @server, @state = number, client, server, state
      @history = [[state, segment.number]]
      @start = @end_time = segment.time
      @packets = @bytes = 0
      @syn = @syn_ack = @handshake_ack = @closer = @final_ack = nil
      @events = []
      @client_side, @server_side = Side.new("client"), Side.new("server")
    end

    def change_state(state, number)
      @state = state
      @history << [state, number]
    end

    def record_syn(side, segment)
      side.isn = segment.seq
      side.mss = segment.packet.value("tcp.options.mss")
      side.wscale = segment.packet.value("tcp.options.wscale")
      if side.equal?(@client_side)
        @syn = segment.number
      else
        @syn_ack = segment.number
      end
    end
  end

  def self.endpoint_pair(first, second) = [first, second].sort

  class StreamTracker
    attr_reader :streams, :duplicate_acks

    def initialize
      @streams, @latest, @duplicate_acks = [], {}, {}
    end

    def open_stream(segment)
      number = @streams.length
      if segment.syn_ack?
        stream = Stream.new(number, segment.destination, segment.source, "SYN_RECEIVED", segment)
        stream.record_syn(stream.server_side, segment)
      elsif segment.syn_only?
        stream = Stream.new(number, segment.source, segment.destination, "SYN_SENT", segment)
        stream.record_syn(stream.client_side, segment)
      else
        stream = Stream.new(number, segment.source, segment.destination, "ESTABLISHED", segment)
      end
      @streams << stream
      stream
    end

    def find_stream(segment)
      key = Flows.endpoint_pair(segment.source, segment.destination)
      stream = @latest[key]
      if stream.nil? || (%w[CLOSED RESET].include?(stream.state) && segment.syn_only?)
        stream = open_stream(segment)
        @latest[key] = stream
      end
      stream
    end

    def track(packet)
      segment = Segment.new(packet)
      stream = find_stream(segment)
      packet.set("tcp.stream", stream.number)
      side, other = if segment.source == stream.client
                      [stream.client_side, stream.server_side]
                    else
                      [stream.server_side, stream.client_side]
                    end
      side.base = segment.seq if side.base.nil?
      other.base = segment.ack if segment.ack? && other.base.nil?
      relative_seq = (segment.seq - side.base) % SEQUENCE_MODULUS
      packet.set("tcp.seq", relative_seq)
      packet.set("tcp.ack", (segment.ack - other.base) % SEQUENCE_MODULUS) if segment.ack?
      analyze(stream, side, segment, relative_seq)
      packet.set("tcp.window.calc", calculated_window(stream, side, segment))
      transition(stream, side, segment)
      side.packets += 1
      side.payload += segment.length
      stream.packets += 1
      stream.bytes += packet.length
      stream.end_time = segment.time
    end

    def sequence_mark(side, start, size, time)
      return nil if side.expected.nil? || start == side.expected
      return "lost_segment" if start > side.expected
      return "retransmission" if side.intervals.key?([start, size])

      time - side.advanced_at < 3000 ? "out_of_order" : "retransmission"
    end

    def analyze(stream, side, segment, start)
      size = segment.length + segment.syn + segment.fin
      mark = nil
      if size >= 1
        mark = sequence_mark(side, start, size, segment.time)
        side.intervals[[start, size]] = true
        if side.expected.nil? || start + size > side.expected
          side.expected, side.advanced_at = start + size, segment.time
        end
      elsif segment.ack? && !segment.rst?
        previous = side.previous_ack
        if previous && segment.ack == previous.ack && segment.window == previous.window
          mark = "duplicate_ack"
          previous.count += 1
          @duplicate_acks[segment.number] = [previous.number, previous.count]
        end
      end
      if segment.ack? && mark != "duplicate_ack"
        side.previous_ack = PreviousAck.new(segment.ack, segment.window, segment.number, 0)
      end
      return if mark.nil?

      segment.packet.set("tcp.analysis.#{mark}", true)
      side.marks[mark] += 1
      stream.events << [segment.number, side.name, mark, start, size]
    end

    def calculated_window(stream, side, segment)
      scaled = !stream.client_side.wscale.nil? && !stream.server_side.wscale.nil?
      scaled && !segment.syn? ? segment.window * 2**side.wscale : segment.window
    end

    def transition(stream, side, segment)
      state, number = stream.state, segment.number
      if segment.rst?
        stream.change_state("RESET", number) unless %w[CLOSED RESET].include?(state)
      elsif state == "SYN_SENT" && segment.syn_ack? && side.equal?(stream.server_side) &&
            segment.ack == (stream.client_side.isn + 1) % SEQUENCE_MODULUS
        stream.change_state("SYN_RECEIVED", number)
        stream.record_syn(stream.server_side, segment)
      elsif state == "SYN_RECEIVED" && side.equal?(stream.client_side) && segment.ack? &&
            !segment.syn? && segment.ack == (stream.server_side.isn + 1) % SEQUENCE_MODULUS
        stream.change_state("ESTABLISHED", number)
        stream.handshake_ack = number
      elsif state == "ESTABLISHED" && segment.fin?
        stream.change_state("FIN_WAIT", number)
        stream.closer = side
      elsif state == "FIN_WAIT" && segment.fin? && !side.equal?(stream.closer)
        stream.change_state("CLOSING", number)
        stream.final_ack = (segment.seq + segment.length + 1) % SEQUENCE_MODULUS
      elsif state == "CLOSING" && side.equal?(stream.closer) && segment.ack? &&
            segment.ack == stream.final_ack
        stream.change_state("CLOSED", number)
      end
    end
  end

  class Conversation
    attr_reader :kind, :endpoint_a, :endpoint_b, :first_number, :first_time,
                :packets_a_to_b, :bytes_a_to_b, :packets_b_to_a, :bytes_b_to_a, :last_time

    def initialize(kind, endpoint_a, endpoint_b, packet)
      @kind, @endpoint_a, @endpoint_b = kind, endpoint_a, endpoint_b
      @first_number, @first_time, @last_time = packet.number, packet.time, packet.time
      @packets_a_to_b = @bytes_a_to_b = @packets_b_to_a = @bytes_b_to_a = 0
    end

    def count(source, packet)
      if source == @endpoint_a
        @packets_a_to_b += 1
        @bytes_a_to_b += packet.length
      else
        @packets_b_to_a += 1
        @bytes_b_to_a += packet.length
      end
      @last_time = packet.time
    end

    def packets = @packets_a_to_b + @packets_b_to_a
    def bytes = @bytes_a_to_b + @bytes_b_to_a
  end

  class Endpoint
    attr_reader :address
    attr_accessor :tx_packets, :tx_bytes, :rx_packets, :rx_bytes

    def initialize(address)
      @address = address
      @tx_packets = @tx_bytes = @rx_packets = @rx_bytes = 0
    end

    def packets = @tx_packets + @rx_packets
    def bytes = @tx_bytes + @rx_bytes
  end

  def self.conversation_views(packet)
    source_ip, destination_ip = packet.value("ip.src"), packet.value("ip.dst")
    views = [["ipv4", endpoint_pair(source_ip, destination_ip),
              [source_ip, nil], [destination_ip, nil]]]
    if packet.exists?("tcp.stream")
      source = [source_ip, packet.value("tcp.srcport")]
      destination = [destination_ip, packet.value("tcp.dstport")]
      views << ["tcp", packet.value("tcp.stream"), source, destination]
    end
    if packet.exists?("udp.srcport")
      source = [source_ip, packet.value("udp.srcport")]
      destination = [destination_ip, packet.value("udp.dstport")]
      views << ["udp", endpoint_pair(source, destination), source, destination]
    end
    views
  end

  def self.build_conversations(packets)
    table = {}
    packets.each do |packet|
      next unless packet.exists?("ip.src")

      conversation_views(packet).each do |kind, key, source, destination|
        conversation = table[[kind, key]] ||= Conversation.new(kind, source, destination, packet)
        conversation.count(source, packet)
      end
    end
    table.values.sort_by do |conversation|
      [-conversation.bytes, -conversation.packets,
       CONVERSATION_KINDS.index(conversation.kind), conversation.first_number]
    end
  end

  def self.build_endpoints(packets)
    table = {}
    packets.each do |packet|
      next unless packet.exists?("ip.src")

      source, destination = packet.value("ip.src"), packet.value("ip.dst")
      sender = table[source] ||= Endpoint.new(source)
      sender.tx_packets += 1
      sender.tx_bytes += packet.length
      receiver = table[destination] ||= Endpoint.new(destination)
      receiver.rx_packets += 1
      receiver.rx_bytes += packet.length
    end
    table.values.sort_by { |endpoint| [-endpoint.bytes, -endpoint.packets, endpoint.address] }
  end
end

class Packet
  attr_reader :number, :time, :length, :data, :layers, :fields
  attr_accessor :error, :remaining

  def initialize(number, time, length)
    @number, @time, @length = number, time, length
    @data, @layers, @fields, @remaining = [], [], {}, []
    @error = nil
  end

  def values(name) = @fields.fetch(name, [])
  def value(name) = @fields[name]&.first
  def exists?(name) = @fields.key?(name)

  def set(name, value)
    @fields[name] = [value]
  end
end

module Hexdump
  DATA_LINE = /\A[0-9a-f]{4}  [0-9a-f]{2}(?: [0-9a-f]{2}){0,15}\z/

  module_function

  def finish_packet(packet)
    return unless packet && packet.error.nil? && packet.data.length != packet.length

    packet.error = "dump: length mismatch (header #{packet.length}, data #{packet.data.length})"
  end

  def read_capture(path)
    packets = []
    packet = nil
    File.foreach(path, chomp: true).with_index(1) do |line, line_number|
      if line.start_with?("PACKET ")
        finish_packet(packet)
        number, time, length = line.split.drop(1).map(&:to_i)
        packet = Packet.new(number, time, length)
        packets << packet
      elsif !line.empty? && packet.error.nil?
        if !DATA_LINE.match?(line)
          packet.error = "dump: bad line #{line_number}"
        elsif line[0, 4].to_i(16) != packet.data.length
          packet.error = "dump: offset mismatch at line #{line_number}"
        else
          packet.data.concat(line[6..].split.map { |byte| byte.to_i(16) })
        end
      end
    end
    finish_packet(packet)
    packets
  end

  def hex_dump_lines(data)
    data.each_slice(16).with_index.map do |piece, index|
      hex = piece.map { |byte| format("%02x", byte) }.join(" ").ljust(47)
      text = piece.map { |byte| byte.between?(32, 126) ? byte.chr : "." }.join
      format("%04x  %s  |%s|", index * 16, hex, text)
    end
  end
end

class Malformed < StandardError; end

class Layer
  attr_reader :fields
  attr_accessor :next_layer, :payload, :remaining

  def initialize
    @fields = {}
    @next_layer = nil
    @payload, @remaining = [], []
  end

  def set(name, value)
    @fields[name] = [value]
  end

  def add(name, value)
    (@fields[name] ||= []) << value
  end

  def forward(name, payload)
    @next_layer, @payload = name, payload
  end
end

module LinkNetwork
  IP_PROTOCOLS = { 1 => "icmp", 17 => "udp", 6 => "tcp" }.freeze

  module_function

  def read_int(data, index, size)
    data[index, size].reduce(0) { |value, byte| value * 256 + byte }
  end

  def checksum_status(data)
    total = data.each_slice(2).sum { |high, low| high * 256 + (low || 0) }
    total = total % 65_536 + total / 65_536 while total > 65_535
    total == 65_535 ? "good" : "bad"
  end

  def mac_notation(value)
    5.downto(0).map { |shift| format("%02x", (value >> (shift * 8)) & 255) }.join(":")
  end

  def ipv4_notation(value)
    3.downto(0).map { |shift| (value >> (shift * 8)) & 255 }.join(".")
  end

  def dissect_ethernet(frame)
    raise Malformed, "eth: truncated" if frame.length < 14

    layer = Layer.new
    ether_type = read_int(frame, 12, 2)
    layer.set("eth.dst", read_int(frame, 0, 6))
    layer.set("eth.src", read_int(frame, 6, 6))
    layer.set("eth.type", ether_type)
    payload = frame[14..]
    case ether_type
    when 0x0806 then layer.forward("arp", payload)
    when 0x0800 then layer.forward("ip", payload)
    else layer.remaining = payload
    end
    layer
  end

  def dissect_arp(message)
    raise Malformed, "arp: truncated" if message.length < 28
    unless read_int(message, 0, 2) == 1 && read_int(message, 2, 2) == 0x0800 &&
           message[4] == 6 && message[5] == 4
      raise Malformed, "arp: unsupported format"
    end

    layer = Layer.new
    layer.set("arp.opcode", read_int(message, 6, 2))
    layer.set("arp.src.hw", read_int(message, 8, 6))
    layer.set("arp.src.ip", read_int(message, 14, 4))
    layer.set("arp.dst.hw", read_int(message, 18, 6))
    layer.set("arp.dst.ip", read_int(message, 24, 4))
    layer
  end

  def dissect_ipv4(datagram)
    available = datagram.length
    raise Malformed, "ip: truncated header" if available < 20

    version = datagram[0] / 16
    raise Malformed, "ip: bad version #{version}" unless version == 4

    header_length = datagram[0] % 16 * 4
    raise Malformed, "ip: bad header length #{header_length}" if header_length < 20
    raise Malformed, "ip: truncated header" if available < header_length

    total_length = read_int(datagram, 2, 2)
    raise Malformed, "ip: bad total length #{total_length}" if total_length < header_length
    if total_length > available
      raise Malformed, "ip: truncated (total length #{total_length}, available #{available})"
    end

    flags = read_int(datagram, 6, 2)
    more_fragments = (flags >> 13) & 1
    offset = (flags & 8191) * 8
    protocol = datagram[9]
    layer = Layer.new
    layer.set("ip.hdr_len", header_length)
    layer.set("ip.tos", datagram[1])
    layer.set("ip.len", total_length)
    layer.set("ip.id", read_int(datagram, 4, 2))
    layer.set("ip.flags.df", (flags >> 14) & 1)
    layer.set("ip.flags.mf", more_fragments)
    layer.set("ip.frag_offset", offset)
    layer.set("ip.ttl", datagram[8])
    layer.set("ip.proto", protocol)
    layer.set("ip.checksum", read_int(datagram, 10, 2))
    layer.set("ip.checksum.status", checksum_status(datagram[0, header_length]))
    layer.set("ip.src", read_int(datagram, 12, 4))
    layer.set("ip.dst", read_int(datagram, 16, 4))
    payload = datagram[header_length...total_length]
    if more_fragments == 1 || offset != 0
      layer.set("ip.fragment", true)
      layer.remaining = payload
    elsif IP_PROTOCOLS.key?(protocol)
      layer.forward(IP_PROTOCOLS[protocol], payload)
    else
      layer.remaining = payload
    end
    layer
  end
end

module Analyzer
  FIELDS = {
    "frame.number" => :integer,
    "frame.time" => :integer,
    "frame.len" => :integer,
    "frame.protocols" => :string,
    "frame.malformed" => :string,
    "frame.bad_checksum" => :presence,
    "eth.dst" => :mac,
    "eth.src" => :mac,
    "eth.type" => :hex4,
    "arp.opcode" => :integer,
    "arp.src.hw" => :mac,
    "arp.src.ip" => :ipv4,
    "arp.dst.hw" => :mac,
    "arp.dst.ip" => :ipv4,
    "ip.hdr_len" => :integer,
    "ip.tos" => :hex2,
    "ip.len" => :integer,
    "ip.id" => :hex4,
    "ip.flags.df" => :integer,
    "ip.flags.mf" => :integer,
    "ip.frag_offset" => :integer,
    "ip.ttl" => :integer,
    "ip.proto" => :integer,
    "ip.checksum" => :hex4,
    "ip.checksum.status" => :string,
    "ip.src" => :ipv4,
    "ip.dst" => :ipv4,
    "ip.fragment" => :presence,
    "icmp.type" => :integer,
    "icmp.code" => :integer,
    "icmp.checksum" => :hex4,
    "icmp.checksum.status" => :string,
    "icmp.id" => :integer,
    "icmp.seq" => :integer,
    "udp.srcport" => :integer,
    "udp.dstport" => :integer,
    "udp.length" => :integer,
    "udp.checksum" => :hex4,
    "udp.checksum.status" => :string,
    "tcp.srcport" => :integer,
    "tcp.dstport" => :integer,
    "tcp.stream" => :integer,
    "tcp.seq" => :integer,
    "tcp.seq_raw" => :integer,
    "tcp.ack" => :integer,
    "tcp.ack_raw" => :integer,
    "tcp.hdr_len" => :integer,
    "tcp.flags" => :hex2,
    "tcp.flags.fin" => :integer,
    "tcp.flags.syn" => :integer,
    "tcp.flags.rst" => :integer,
    "tcp.flags.psh" => :integer,
    "tcp.flags.ack" => :integer,
    "tcp.flags.urg" => :integer,
    "tcp.window" => :integer,
    "tcp.window.calc" => :integer,
    "tcp.checksum" => :hex4,
    "tcp.checksum.status" => :string,
    "tcp.urgent" => :integer,
    "tcp.option" => :string,
    "tcp.options.mss" => :integer,
    "tcp.options.wscale" => :integer,
    "tcp.options.malformed" => :presence,
    "tcp.len" => :integer,
    "tcp.analysis.retransmission" => :presence,
    "tcp.analysis.out_of_order" => :presence,
    "tcp.analysis.lost_segment" => :presence,
    "tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack" => :presence,
    "dns.id" => :hex4,
    "dns.flags" => :hex4,
    "dns.flags.response" => :integer,
    "dns.flags.opcode" => :integer,
    "dns.flags.rcode" => :integer,
    "dns.count.queries" => :integer,
    "dns.count.answers" => :integer,
    "dns.count.auth_rr" => :integer,
    "dns.count.add_rr" => :integer,
    "dns.qry.name" => :string,
    "dns.qry.type" => :integer,
    "dns.answer" => :string,
    "dns.authority" => :string,
    "dns.additional" => :string,
    "dns.a" => :ipv4,
    "data.len" => :integer
  }.freeze
  ALIASES = {
    "eth.addr" => [:mac, "eth.dst", "eth.src"],
    "ip.addr" => [:ipv4, "ip.src", "ip.dst"],
    "udp.port" => [:integer, "udp.srcport", "udp.dstport"],
    "tcp.port" => [:integer, "tcp.srcport", "tcp.dstport"]
  }.freeze
  PROTOCOL_FIELDS = %w[eth arp ip icmp udp tcp dns data].freeze
  PROTOCOL_LABELS = { "eth" => "ETH", "arp" => "ARP", "ip" => "IPv4", "icmp" => "ICMP",
                      "udp" => "UDP", "tcp" => "TCP", "dns" => "DNS" }.freeze
  CHECKSUM_LAYERS = [["ip", "IPv4"], ["icmp", "ICMP"], ["udp", "UDP"], ["tcp", "TCP"]].freeze
  FLAG_NAMES = %w[FIN SYN RST PSH ACK URG ECE CWR].freeze
  MARK_LABELS = {
    "retransmission" => "[TCP Retransmission] ",
    "out_of_order" => "[TCP Out-Of-Order] ",
    "lost_segment" => "[TCP Previous segment not captured] "
  }.freeze
  TWO_CHARACTER_TOKENS = %w[== != <= >= && ||].freeze
  KEYWORDS = { "and" => "&&", "or" => "||", "not" => "!" }.freeze
  WORD_CHARACTER = /[A-Za-z0-9._:]/
  COMPARISONS = %w[== != < > <= >=].freeze
  HIERARCHY = [["eth", 0], ["arp", 2], ["ip", 2], ["icmp", 4], ["udp", 4],
               ["dns", 6], ["tcp", 4]].freeze
  MALFORMED_LAYERS = %w[eth arp ip icmp udp tcp dns].freeze
  CONVERSATION_HEADER = "type,endpoint_a,endpoint_b,packets,bytes,packets_a_to_b," \
                        "bytes_a_to_b,packets_b_to_a,bytes_b_to_a,start,duration"
  ENDPOINT_HEADER = "address,packets,bytes,tx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_packets,rx_bytes"

  module_function

  def seconds(time) = format("%d.%06d", time / 1_000_000, time % 1_000_000)
  def optional(value) = value.nil? ? "-" : value.to_s

  def notation(type, value)
    case type
    when :hex2 then format("0x%02x", value)
    when :hex4 then format("0x%04x", value)
    when :ipv4 then LinkNetwork.ipv4_notation(value)
    when :mac then LinkNetwork.mac_notation(value)
    else value.to_s
    end
  end

  def shown(packet, name) = notation(FIELDS.fetch(name), packet.value(name))

  def endpoint_text(endpoint)
    address, port = endpoint
    text = LinkNetwork.ipv4_notation(address)
    port.nil? ? text : "#{text}:#{port}"
  end

  def field_type_of(name)
    return FIELDS[name] if FIELDS.key?(name)
    return ALIASES[name][0] if ALIASES.key?(name)
    return :presence if PROTOCOL_FIELDS.include?(name)

    nil
  end

  def field_values(packet, name)
    if ALIASES.key?(name)
      _, first, second = ALIASES[name]
      packet.values(first) + packet.values(second)
    else
      packet.values(name)
    end
  end

  def dissect_layer(packet, name, payload)
    case name
    when "eth" then LinkNetwork.dissect_ethernet(payload)
    when "arp" then LinkNetwork.dissect_arp(payload)
    when "ip" then LinkNetwork.dissect_ipv4(payload)
    when "icmp" then Transport.dissect_icmp(payload)
    when "udp" then Transport.dissect_udp(payload, packet.value("ip.src"), packet.value("ip.dst"))
    when "tcp" then Transport.dissect_tcp(payload, packet.value("ip.src"), packet.value("ip.dst"))
    when "dns" then DnsApp.dissect_dns(payload)
    end
  end

  def dissect_layers(packet)
    name, payload = "eth", packet.data
    loop do
      packet.layers << name
      layer = dissect_layer(packet, name, payload)
      packet.fields.merge!(layer.fields)
      if layer.next_layer.nil?
        packet.remaining = layer.remaining
        return nil
      end
      name, payload = layer.next_layer, layer.payload
    end
  rescue Malformed => error
    error.message
  end

  def dissect(packet, base_time)
    reason = packet.error || dissect_layers(packet)
    if reason.nil? && !packet.remaining.empty?
      packet.layers << "data"
      packet.set("data.len", packet.remaining.length)
    end
    packet.set("frame.number", packet.number)
    packet.set("frame.time", packet.time - base_time)
    packet.set("frame.len", packet.length)
    packet.set("frame.protocols", packet.layers.join(":")) unless packet.layers.empty?
    packet.set("frame.malformed", reason) unless reason.nil?
    if CHECKSUM_LAYERS.any? { |layer, _| packet.value("#{layer}.checksum.status") == "bad" }
      packet.set("frame.bad_checksum", true)
    end
  end

  def addresses(packet)
    if packet.exists?("ip.src")
      [shown(packet, "ip.src"), shown(packet, "ip.dst")]
    elsif packet.exists?("eth.src")
      [shown(packet, "eth.src"), shown(packet, "eth.dst")]
    else
      ["-", "-"]
    end
  end

  def protocol_label(packet)
    layer = packet.layers.reverse.find { |name| name != "data" }
    layer ? PROTOCOL_LABELS.fetch(layer) : "DUMP"
  end

  def arp_info(packet)
    case packet.value("arp.opcode")
    when 1 then "Who has #{shown(packet, 'arp.dst.ip')}? Tell #{shown(packet, 'arp.src.ip')}"
    when 2 then "#{shown(packet, 'arp.src.ip')} is at #{shown(packet, 'arp.src.hw')}"
    else "Opcode #{packet.value('arp.opcode')}"
    end
  end

  def ipv4_info(packet)
    return "Protocol #{packet.value('ip.proto')}" unless packet.exists?("ip.fragment")

    text = "Fragment id=#{shown(packet, 'ip.id')} off=#{packet.value('ip.frag_offset')}"
    text += " MF" if packet.value("ip.flags.mf") == 1
    text
  end

  def icmp_info(packet)
    type = packet.value("icmp.type")
    if [0, 8].include?(type)
      kind = type == 8 ? "request" : "reply"
      "Echo #{kind} id=#{packet.value('icmp.id')} seq=#{packet.value('icmp.seq')}"
    else
      "Type #{type} code #{packet.value('icmp.code')}"
    end
  end

  def mark_notation(packet, duplicate_acks)
    if packet.exists?("tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack")
      original, count = duplicate_acks.fetch(packet.number)
      return "[TCP Dup ACK #{original}##{count}] "
    end
    MARK_LABELS.each do |mark, label|
      return label if packet.exists?("tcp.analysis.#{mark}")
    end
    ""
  end

  def flag_notation(flags)
    names = FLAG_NAMES.each_with_index.filter_map { |name, bit| name unless ((flags >> bit) & 1).zero? }
    names.empty? ? "<None>" : names.join(", ")
  end

  def option_summary(options)
    options.map do |option|
      words = option.split
      case words[0]
      when "MSS" then " MSS=#{words[1]}"
      when "WS" then " WS=#{2**words[1].to_i}"
      when "SACK_PERM" then " SACK_PERM"
      when "TS" then " TSval=#{words[1]} TSecr=#{words[2]}"
      else ""
      end
    end.join
  end

  def tcp_info(packet, duplicate_acks)
    text = mark_notation(packet, duplicate_acks) +
           "#{packet.value('tcp.srcport')} -> #{packet.value('tcp.dstport')}" +
           " [#{flag_notation(packet.value('tcp.flags'))}] Seq=#{packet.value('tcp.seq')}"
    text += " Ack=#{packet.value('tcp.ack')}" if packet.value("tcp.flags.ack") == 1
    text += " Win=#{packet.value('tcp.window.calc')} Len=#{packet.value('tcp.len')}"
    text + option_summary(packet.values("tcp.option"))
  end

  def dns_info(packet)
    parts = [packet.value("dns.flags.response") == 1 ? "Response" : "Query", shown(packet, "dns.id")]
    rcode = packet.value("dns.flags.rcode")
    parts << DnsApp.rcode_name(rcode) unless rcode.zero?
    packet.values("dns.qry.name").zip(packet.values("dns.qry.type")) do |name, type|
      parts.concat([DnsApp.type_name(type), name])
    end
    packet.values("dns.answer").each do |record|
      _, type, _, _, rdata = record.split(" ", 5)
      parts.concat([type, rdata])
    end
    parts.join(" ")
  end

  def basic_info(packet, protocol, duplicate_acks)
    return packet.value("frame.malformed") if packet.exists?("frame.malformed")

    case protocol
    when "ETH" then "EtherType #{shown(packet, 'eth.type')}"
    when "ARP" then arp_info(packet)
    when "IPv4" then ipv4_info(packet)
    when "ICMP" then icmp_info(packet)
    when "UDP"
      "#{packet.value('udp.srcport')} -> #{packet.value('udp.dstport')} Len=#{packet.value('udp.length') - 8}"
    when "TCP" then tcp_info(packet, duplicate_acks)
    when "DNS" then dns_info(packet)
    end
  end

  def annotations(packet)
    text = packet.exists?("tcp.options.malformed") ? " [bad TCP options]" : ""
    CHECKSUM_LAYERS.each do |layer, label|
      text += " [bad #{label} checksum]" if packet.value("#{layer}.checksum.status") == "bad"
    end
    text
  end

  def summary_line(packet, duplicate_acks)
    source, destination = addresses(packet)
    protocol = protocol_label(packet)
    info = basic_info(packet, protocol, duplicate_acks) + annotations(packet)
    "#{packet.number} #{seconds(packet.value('frame.time'))} #{source} -> #{destination} " \
      "#{protocol} #{packet.length} #{info}"
  end

  class FilterError < StandardError; end
  Token = Data.define(:kind, :text, :column)

  def tokenize(expression)
    tokens = []
    index = 0
    while index < expression.length
      character, column = expression[index], index + 1
      pair = expression[index, 2]
      if character == " "
        index += 1
      elsif TWO_CHARACTER_TOKENS.include?(pair)
        tokens << Token.new(pair, pair, column)
        index += 2
      elsif "()!<>".include?(character)
        tokens << Token.new(character, character, column)
        index += 1
      elsif character == '"'
        finish = expression.index('"', index + 1)
        raise FilterError, "unterminated string at column #{column}" if finish.nil?

        tokens << Token.new("string", expression[index..finish], column)
        index = finish + 1
      elsif WORD_CHARACTER.match?(character)
        finish = index
        finish += 1 while finish < expression.length && WORD_CHARACTER.match?(expression[finish])
        word = expression[index...finish]
        tokens << Token.new(KEYWORDS.fetch(word, "word"), word, column)
        index = finish
      else
        raise FilterError, "invalid character '#{character}' at column #{column}"
      end
    end
    tokens
  end

  def parse_number(text)
    return text.to_i if /\A[0-9]{1,15}\z/.match?(text)
    return text[2..].to_i(16) if /\A0x[0-9a-fA-F]{1,12}\z/.match?(text)

    nil
  end

  def parse_ipv4(text)
    parts = text.split(".", -1)
    return nil unless parts.length == 4
    return nil unless parts.all? { |part| /\A[0-9]{1,3}\z/.match?(part) && part.to_i <= 255 }

    parts.reduce(0) { |address, part| address * 256 + part.to_i }
  end

  def parse_mac(text)
    parts = text.split(":", -1)
    return nil unless parts.length == 6 && parts.all? { |part| /\A[0-9a-fA-F]{2}\z/.match?(part) }

    parts.reduce(0) { |address, part| address * 256 + part.to_i(16) }
  end

  def convert_value(type, token)
    return token.kind == "string" ? token.text[1...-1] : nil if type == :string
    return nil unless token.kind == "word"

    case type
    when :integer, :hex2, :hex4 then parse_number(token.text)
    when :ipv4 then parse_ipv4(token.text)
    when :mac then parse_mac(token.text)
    end
  end

  def unexpected(token)
    FilterError.new("unexpected '#{token.text}' at column #{token.column}")
  end

  class FilterParser
    def initialize(tokens)
      @tokens, @position = tokens, 0
    end

    def next_kind = @tokens[@position]&.kind

    def take
      raise FilterError, "unexpected end of filter" if @position >= @tokens.length

      token = @tokens[@position]
      @position += 1
      token
    end

    def parse
      node = expression
      raise Analyzer.unexpected(@tokens[@position]) if @position < @tokens.length

      node
    end

    def expression
      node = product
      while next_kind == "||"
        take
        node = [:or, node, product]
      end
      node
    end

    def product
      node = negation
      while next_kind == "&&"
        take
        node = [:and, node, negation]
      end
      node
    end

    def negation
      if next_kind == "!"
        take
        return [:not, negation]
      end
      token = take
      if token.kind == "("
        node = expression
        closing = take
        raise Analyzer.unexpected(closing) unless closing.kind == ")"

        node
      elsif token.kind == "word"
        read_test(token.text)
      else
        raise Analyzer.unexpected(token)
      end
    end

    def read_test(name)
      type = Analyzer.field_type_of(name)
      raise FilterError, "unknown field #{name}" if type.nil?
      return [:exists, name] unless COMPARISONS.include?(next_kind)

      operator = take.kind
      if type == :presence || (type == :string && !%w[== !=].include?(operator))
        raise FilterError, "operator #{operator} not allowed for #{name}"
      end
      token = take
      raise Analyzer.unexpected(token) unless %w[word string].include?(token.kind)

      value = Analyzer.convert_value(type, token)
      raise FilterError, "invalid value #{token.text} for #{name}" if value.nil?

      [:compare, name, operator, value]
    end
  end

  def compare(left, operator, right)
    case operator
    when "==" then left == right
    when "<" then left < right
    when ">" then left > right
    when "<=" then left <= right
    when ">=" then left >= right
    end
  end

  def evaluate(node, packet)
    case node[0]
    when :or then evaluate(node[1], packet) || evaluate(node[2], packet)
    when :and then evaluate(node[1], packet) && evaluate(node[2], packet)
    when :not then !evaluate(node[1], packet)
    when :exists
      name = node[1]
      PROTOCOL_FIELDS.include?(name) ? packet.layers.include?(name) : !field_values(packet, name).empty?
    when :compare
      _, name, operator, expected = node
      values = field_values(packet, name)
      return false if values.empty?

      if operator == "!="
        values.all? { |value| value != expected }
      else
        values.any? { |value| compare(value, operator, expected) }
      end
    end
  end

  def filter_block(expression, packets, summaries)
    lines = ["", "filter #{expression}"]
    begin
      tree = FilterParser.new(tokenize(expression)).parse
    rescue FilterError => error
      return lines << "error: #{error.message}"
    end
    matched = packets.select { |packet| evaluate(tree, packet) }
    lines.concat(matched.map { |packet| summaries[packet.number - 1] })
    lines << "matched #{matched.length} of #{packets.length}"
  end

  def detail_lines(packets, number)
    return ["packet #{number} not found"] unless number.between?(1, packets.length)

    packet = packets[number - 1]
    lines = ["packet #{number}"]
    (["frame"] + packet.layers).each do |layer|
      lines << layer
      FIELDS.each do |name, type|
        next unless name.start_with?("#{layer}.")

        packet.values(name).each do |value|
          lines << (type == :presence ? "  #{name}" : "  #{name} = #{notation(type, value)}")
        end
      end
      lines.concat(Hexdump.hex_dump_lines(packet.remaining).map { |line| "  #{line}" }) if layer == "data"
    end
    lines
  end

  def is_answer?(query, response)
    query.value("dns.id") == response.value("dns.id") &&
      query.value("ip.src") == response.value("ip.dst") &&
      query.value("udp.srcport") == response.value("udp.dstport") &&
      query.value("ip.dst") == response.value("ip.src") &&
      query.value("udp.dstport") == response.value("udp.srcport")
  end

  class DnsTransactions
    attr_reader :queries, :responses, :response_times, :unanswered

    def initialize(packets)
      @queries, @responses, @response_times = [], [], []
      pending = []
      packets.each do |packet|
        next unless packet.exists?("dns.id")

        if packet.value("dns.flags.response").zero?
          @queries << packet
          pending << packet
        else
          @responses << packet
          index = pending.index { |query| Analyzer.is_answer?(query, packet) }
          unless index.nil?
            query = pending.delete_at(index)
            @response_times << packet.time - query.time
          end
        end
      end
      @unanswered = pending.length
    end
  end

  def layer_statistics(packets)
    lines = ["hierarchy"]
    HIERARCHY.each do |name, indent|
      members = packets.select { |packet| packet.layers.include?(name) }
      lines << "#{' ' * indent}#{name} #{members.length} #{members.sum(&:length)}"
    end
    lines << "checksums"
    CHECKSUM_LAYERS.each do |layer, _|
      statuses = packets.map { |packet| packet.value("#{layer}.checksum.status") }
      line = "#{layer} good #{statuses.count('good')} bad #{statuses.count('bad')}"
      line += " none #{statuses.count('none')}" if layer == "udp"
      lines << line
    end
    lines.concat(["malformed", "dump #{packets.count { |packet| !packet.error.nil? }}"])
    MALFORMED_LAYERS.each do |name|
      count = packets.count do |packet|
        packet.error.nil? && packet.exists?("frame.malformed") && packet.layers.last == name
      end
      lines << "#{name} #{count}"
    end
    lines << "tcp analysis"
    Flows::MARKS.each do |mark|
      lines << "#{mark} #{packets.count { |packet| packet.exists?("tcp.analysis.#{mark}") }}"
    end
    lines
  end

  def dns_statistics(transactions)
    times = transactions.response_times
    lines = ["dns", "queries #{transactions.queries.length}", "responses #{transactions.responses.length}",
             "transactions #{times.length}", "unanswered #{transactions.unanswered}"]
    lines << if times.empty?
               "response_time -"
             else
               "response_time min #{seconds(times.min)} max #{seconds(times.max)}"
             end
    rcodes = transactions.responses.map { |packet| packet.value("dns.flags.rcode") }.tally
    16.times do |rcode|
      lines << "rcode #{DnsApp.rcode_name(rcode)} #{rcodes[rcode]}" if rcodes.key?(rcode)
    end
    lines << "names"
    names = transactions.queries.flat_map { |packet| packet.values("dns.qry.name") }.tally
    names.sort_by { |name, count| [-count, name] }.each { |name, count| lines << "#{name} #{count}" }
    lines
  end

  def protocol_stats_lines(packets, transactions)
    ["packets #{packets.length}", "bytes #{packets.sum(&:length)}",
     "duration #{seconds(packets.last.time - packets.first.time)}"] +
      layer_statistics(packets) + dns_statistics(transactions)
  end

  def conversation_lines(conversations, base_time)
    [CONVERSATION_HEADER] + conversations.map do |conversation|
      [conversation.kind, endpoint_text(conversation.endpoint_a), endpoint_text(conversation.endpoint_b),
       conversation.packets, conversation.bytes, conversation.packets_a_to_b, conversation.bytes_a_to_b,
       conversation.packets_b_to_a, conversation.bytes_b_to_a, seconds(conversation.first_time - base_time),
       seconds(conversation.last_time - conversation.first_time)].join(",")
    end
  end

  def endpoint_lines(endpoints)
    [ENDPOINT_HEADER] + endpoints.map do |endpoint|
      [LinkNetwork.ipv4_notation(endpoint.address), endpoint.packets, endpoint.bytes,
       endpoint.tx_packets, endpoint.tx_bytes, endpoint.rx_packets, endpoint.rx_bytes].join(",")
    end
  end

  def side_line(side)
    counts = Flows::MARKS.map { |mark| "#{mark} #{side.marks[mark]}" }.join(" ")
    "#{side.name} packets #{side.packets} payload #{side.payload} #{counts}"
  end

  def stream_lines(stream, packets)
    client, server = stream.client_side, stream.server_side
    rtt = if stream.syn && stream.handshake_ack
            seconds(packets[stream.handshake_ack - 1].time - packets[stream.syn - 1].time)
          else
            "-"
          end
    history = stream.history.map { |state, number| "#{state} #{number}" }.join(", ")
    lines = [
      "stream #{stream.number} #{endpoint_text(stream.client)} -> #{endpoint_text(stream.server)}",
      "packets #{stream.packets} bytes #{stream.bytes} start #{seconds(stream.start - packets.first.time)}" \
        " duration #{seconds(stream.end_time - stream.start)}",
      "states #{history}",
      "handshake syn #{optional(stream.syn)} syn_ack #{optional(stream.syn_ack)}" \
        " ack #{optional(stream.handshake_ack)} rtt #{rtt}",
      "options client mss #{optional(client.mss)} wscale #{optional(client.wscale)}" \
        " server mss #{optional(server.mss)} wscale #{optional(server.wscale)}",
      side_line(client), side_line(server)
    ]
    stream.events.each do |number, side, mark, start, size|
      lines << "event #{number} #{side} #{mark} seq #{start} len #{size}"
    end
    lines
  end

  def joined_blocks(blocks)
    blocks.each_with_index.flat_map { |block, index| index.zero? ? block : [""] + block }
  end

  def read_requests(path)
    filters, details = [], []
    File.foreach(path, chomp: true) do |line|
      if line.start_with?("FILTER ")
        filters << line[7..]
      elsif line.start_with?("DETAIL ")
        details << line[7..].to_i
      end
    end
    [filters, details]
  end

  def write_lines(name, lines)
    File.binwrite(File.join("output", name), lines.map { |line| "#{line}\n" }.join)
  end

  def main
    packets = Hexdump.read_capture(File.join("input", "capture.txt"))
    filters, detail_numbers = read_requests(File.join("input", "filters.txt"))
    base_time = packets.first.time
    packets.each { |packet| dissect(packet, base_time) }
    tracker = Flows::StreamTracker.new
    packets.each { |packet| tracker.track(packet) if packet.exists?("tcp.srcport") }
    summaries = packets.map { |packet| summary_line(packet, tracker.duplicate_acks) }
    summary = summaries.dup
    filters.each { |expression| summary.concat(filter_block(expression, packets, summaries)) }
    details = joined_blocks(detail_numbers.map { |number| detail_lines(packets, number) })
    streams = joined_blocks(tracker.streams.map { |stream| stream_lines(stream, packets) })
    FileUtils.mkdir_p("output")
    write_lines("summary.txt", summary)
    write_lines("details.txt", details)
    write_lines("conversations.csv", conversation_lines(Flows.build_conversations(packets), base_time))
    write_lines("endpoints.csv", endpoint_lines(Flows.build_endpoints(packets)))
    write_lines("protocol_stats.txt", protocol_stats_lines(packets, DnsTransactions.new(packets)))
    write_lines("tcp_streams.txt", streams)
  end
end

require_relative "link_network"

module Transport
  FLAG_FIELDS = %w[fin syn rst psh ack urg].freeze
  OPTION_LENGTHS = { 2 => [4], 3 => [3], 4 => [2], 5 => [10, 18, 26, 34], 8 => [10] }.freeze

  module_function

  def pseudo_header(source, destination, protocol, length)
    [source, destination].flat_map do |address|
      3.downto(0).map { |shift| (address >> (shift * 8)) & 255 }
    end + [0, protocol, length / 256, length % 256]
  end

  def dissect_icmp(message)
    raise Malformed, "icmp: truncated" if message.length < 8

    layer = Layer.new
    type = message[0]
    layer.set("icmp.type", type)
    layer.set("icmp.code", message[1])
    layer.set("icmp.checksum", LinkNetwork.read_int(message, 2, 2))
    layer.set("icmp.checksum.status", LinkNetwork.checksum_status(message))
    if [0, 8].include?(type)
      layer.set("icmp.id", LinkNetwork.read_int(message, 4, 2))
      layer.set("icmp.seq", LinkNetwork.read_int(message, 6, 2))
    end
    layer.remaining = message[8..]
    layer
  end

  def dissect_udp(datagram, source, destination)
    raise Malformed, "udp: truncated" if datagram.length < 8

    length = LinkNetwork.read_int(datagram, 4, 2)
    raise Malformed, "udp: bad length #{length}" if length < 8 || length > datagram.length

    source_port = LinkNetwork.read_int(datagram, 0, 2)
    destination_port = LinkNetwork.read_int(datagram, 2, 2)
    checksum = LinkNetwork.read_int(datagram, 6, 2)
    status = if checksum.zero?
               "none"
             else
               covered = pseudo_header(source, destination, 17, length) + datagram[0, length]
               LinkNetwork.checksum_status(covered)
             end
    layer = Layer.new
    layer.set("udp.srcport", source_port)
    layer.set("udp.dstport", destination_port)
    layer.set("udp.length", length)
    layer.set("udp.checksum", checksum)
    layer.set("udp.checksum.status", status)
    payload = datagram[8...length]
    if source_port == 53 || destination_port == 53
      layer.forward("dns", payload)
    else
      layer.remaining = payload
    end
    layer
  end

  def option_text(kind, length, body, layer)
    case kind
    when 2
      mss = LinkNetwork.read_int(body, 0, 2)
      layer.set("tcp.options.mss", mss)
      "MSS #{mss}"
    when 3
      layer.set("tcp.options.wscale", body[0])
      "WS #{body[0]}"
    when 4 then "SACK_PERM"
    when 5
      blocks = body.each_slice(8).map do |block|
        " #{LinkNetwork.read_int(block, 0, 4)}-#{LinkNetwork.read_int(block, 4, 4)}"
      end
      "SACK#{blocks.join}"
    when 8 then "TS #{LinkNetwork.read_int(body, 0, 4)} #{LinkNetwork.read_int(body, 4, 4)}"
    else "kind #{kind} len #{length}"
    end
  end

  def parse_options(options, layer)
    index = 0
    while index < options.length
      kind = options[index]
      if kind == 0
        layer.add("tcp.option", "EOL")
        return
      elsif kind == 1
        layer.add("tcp.option", "NOP")
        index += 1
        next
      end
      length = options[index + 1] || 0
      if length < 2 || index + length > options.length ||
         (OPTION_LENGTHS.key?(kind) && !OPTION_LENGTHS[kind].include?(length))
        layer.set("tcp.options.malformed", true)
        return
      end
      body = options[index + 2, length - 2]
      layer.add("tcp.option", option_text(kind, length, body, layer))
      index += length
    end
  end

  def dissect_tcp(segment, source, destination)
    raise Malformed, "tcp: truncated header" if segment.length < 20

    header_length = segment[12] / 16 * 4
    raise Malformed, "tcp: bad header length #{header_length}" if header_length < 20
    raise Malformed, "tcp: truncated header" if header_length > segment.length

    flags = segment[13]
    covered = pseudo_header(source, destination, 6, segment.length) + segment
    layer = Layer.new
    layer.set("tcp.srcport", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 0, 2))
    layer.set("tcp.dstport", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 2, 2))
    layer.set("tcp.seq_raw", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 4, 4))
    layer.set("tcp.hdr_len", header_length)
    layer.set("tcp.flags", flags)
    FLAG_FIELDS.each_with_index { |name, bit| layer.set("tcp.flags.#{name}", (flags >> bit) & 1) }
    layer.set("tcp.window", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 14, 2))
    layer.set("tcp.checksum", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 16, 2))
    layer.set("tcp.checksum.status", LinkNetwork.checksum_status(covered))
    layer.set("tcp.urgent", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 18, 2))
    layer.set("tcp.len", segment.length - header_length)
    layer.set("tcp.ack_raw", LinkNetwork.read_int(segment, 8, 4)) unless (flags & 16).zero?
    parse_options(segment[20...header_length], layer)
    layer.remaining = segment[header_length..]
    layer
  end
end
